analysis.executive_summary: Audit of docs.turnkey.com crawled 603 of 672 requested pages (100% coverage within scope). Documentation contains 32 confirmed broken internal links affecting user navigation. API reference coverage is critically low at 1.6% despite detecting 163 API pages. Example code reliability scored 0% across all pages, indicating a detection limitation with JavaScript-rendered content. SEO/metadata issues affect 15% of pages and freshness timestamps appear on only 0.5% of documentation.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage achieved (100% of in-scope pages)
Large API surface detected (163 API pages identified)
Single-product topology provides clear documentation structure
risks: 32 broken internal documentation links create poor user experience and navigation dead-ends
API reference coverage at 1.6% leaves 98.4% of API endpoints without usage documentation
Example code reliability at 0% suggests widespread detection failure or absent runnable examples
SEO/metadata issues on 15% of pages harm discoverability and search ranking
Freshness timestamps missing on 99.5% of pages prevent users from assessing content currency
8 unverified links may be broken but blocked by auth/rate-limiting during audit
69 pages discovered but not crawled (672 requested vs 603 crawled) may contain additional issues

prioritized_actions.action: Fix all 32 broken internal documentation links to restore navigation integrity
Audit and expand API usage documentation from 1.6% to minimum 60% coverage of 163 detected API pages
Investigate example code rendering (likely JS-based) and implement server-side detection or add static code block markers
Add last-updated timestamps to all documentation pages (currently 0.5% coverage)
Resolve SEO/metadata issues affecting 15% of pages (91 pages) to improve search discoverability

limitations: Example code reliability at 0% indicates detection failure on JavaScript-rendered content; actual example quality cannot be assessed
8 unverified links blocked by authentication or rate-limiting may include additional broken links not counted in the 32 confirmed
External audit cannot verify accuracy, completeness, or technical correctness of documentation content
API coverage measurement depends on pattern detection; custom API documentation structures may be undercounted
69 pages not crawled (out of 672 requested) may contain additional broken links, SEO issues, or coverage gaps not reflected in this analysis
